name: George Alexander Foundation Scholarship
summary: Up to $30,000 over three years for recent school leavers relocating to study a Griffith undergraduate degree.
key: From 2027 the maximum value is $30,000, paid in instalments over a maximum of three years.
who: Completed secondary school within the last two years and not started at another university.
Relocating, or needing to move away from home, to study an undergraduate degree.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
